text: {"lessons":["With prices moving randomly, recent gains or losses do not reliably predict what comes next; avoid trading on short-term price movements alone.","The decline in my account is uncomfortable, but I should assess risk and diversification rather than make a rushed decision to sell or hold everything.","My tendency to feel losses more strongly and enjoy locking in gains can bias my choices, so I should use a consistent plan instead of letting those feelings drive trades."]}
